title: Reverse Survivors gameplay extension: enemies, statuses, director powers, difficulty
objective: Extend the game with four systems, landed as four independently-green commits: new enemy kinds; survivor status debuffs (slow/suppress/bleed); director powers that buy back placement control (ambush/frenzy/rift); and difficulty tiers. Each commit must typecheck, lint at --max-warnings 0, and hold 100% coverage on its own, so the history stays bisectable.
acceptance_criteria: Every commit passes `npm run check` in reverse_survivors/ standalone: tsc --noEmit clean, eslint --max-warnings 0 clean, vitest at 100% statements/branches/functions/lines.
No lint suppressions, @ts-ignore, or coverage excludes are introduced.
New status logic contributes zero branches, verified against the v8 branch count.
Seeded replays stay deterministic: the same seed and action sequence produce identical outcomes.
The game runs and both sides can still win, verified by driving the real simulation rather than tests alone.
out_of_scope: Endless mode: fmtTime(Infinity) renders Infinity:NaN and would need a guard plus tests for a mode whose only content is the same game but longer.
localStorage difficulty persistence: its catch arm is only reachable by stubbing a throwing setItem, which tests the mock rather than the game.
The pending dependency refresh (7 packages one patch behind) ships separately.
Rebalancing the pre-existing economy, where a trickle strategy loses to the survivor's kill rate.
verifier: npm run check (typecheck + eslint --max-warnings 0 + vitest --coverage at 100%), npm run build, and a headless full-game playtest driving src/core/sim.ts via vite-node
